Lemma
[The Adapted Frame Along a Hypersurface]

↗ def:unit-normal ↗ def:metric-preserving ↗ def:normal-space

If $F:M\to \widetilde M$ is an isometric immersion of an $n$-manifold into an $(n+1)$-manifold, $N_x$ is unit normal, and $(E_i)$ is a $g$-orthonormal basis of $T_xM$, then $(N_x,dF_xE_1,\ldots ,dF_xE_n)$ is an orthonormal family in $T_{F(x)}\widetilde M$.

Proof

↗ def:unit-normal ↗ def:metric-preserving \sketch Normality makes the cross terms zero, the unit-normal condition gives the first norm, and metric preservation gives $\widetilde g(dF_xE_i,dF_xE_j)=g(E_i,E_j)=\delta _{ij}$.

□
